subject: general
question:
Study the given bar graph and answer the question that follows.

The bar graph shows the exports of cars of type A and B (in ₹ millions) from 2014 2018.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3771da3bb1f268bc13a10b7d0ab112660421c1b138c5bf5b1cbdec537d33f8d1.png] 

The total exports of cars of type A from 2014 to 2016 is approximately what percentage less than the total exports of cars of type B from 2015 to 2017 (correct to one decimal place)?
solution:
Calculation:

The total exports of cars of type A from 2014 to 2016 = 200 + 150 + 275 = 625M

The total exports of cars of type B from 2015 to 2017 = 250 + 200 + 275 = 725M

Now, % less = {{725M - 625M} over 725M} times 100\%

⇒ 13.79% ≈ 13.8%

**∴ The total exports of cars of type A from 2014 to 2016 is approximately 13.8% less than the total exports of cars of type B from 2015 to 2017.**
